name: Multi-Isosurface Extraction
definition: A technique to extract and render multiple isosurfaces from the same scalar volume data simultaneously by running the Marching Cubes algorithm for each selected isovalue.
summary: Multi-Isosurface Extraction simultaneously extracts and renders multiple isosurfaces from scalar volume data by iterating the Marching Cubes algorithm over a user-defined list of isovalue thresholds.
